assessments.reasoning: In epl10_terms [3552,4573), the §3 opening identifies the actor, form and own-agreement condition. Paragraph (b) places the statement in that agreement. Subparagraph (iv) ties the source to the same Contributor and expressly requires acquisition instructions.

limitations: Section 3(a) requires compliance with the EPL. Section 3(b)(i)–(iii) separately addresses warranty disclaimers, liability exclusions and responsibility for differing terms.
Whether an identified channel actually provides the relevant source reasonably depends on facts about the distribution.
reasoning: For a Contributor choosing its own agreement for object-code distribution, §3(b)(iv) prescribes two things that agreement must tell licensees: the distributing Contributor makes the Program source available, and licensees can obtain it by a specified, reasonable means using a customary software-exchange medium.
